name: panel-prepower
summary: Power the panel up (backlight off) during start-up; the 550 ms panel wait runs as a timer in the main loop instead of blocking the start
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-07 (v2): deep-standby wake 6.7-6.9 s (3 runs, with port-accept), power-key start 6.6 s, mains ~11.9 s; power-off right after a start and No signal -> deep standby -> wake OK

edits.asm: panel-prepower v2 code part 1 in linker padding (0x203A00); PST/PREQ at 0x203FF0/0x203FF1; ISR timer slot 8
panel-prepower v2 code part 2 (panel-off hooks, boot hook) in linker padding (0x203B08)
b.lbz r6,0x51a8(r10) -> b.j 0x203a00 (sub_245919 entry: lbz r6,pnl -> preparation check)
b.ori r3,r0,0x226 -> b.j 0x203a34 (sub_245919 550 ms wait: countdown instead of busy-wait when preparing)
b.lbz r6,0x51a8(r7) -> b.j 0x203b08 (sub_245860 guard: also run while a preparation is in progress)
b.sb 0x51a8(r7),r0 -> b.j 0x203b1f (sub_245860: clear preparation state with pnl)
b.jal 0x22f2c7 -> b.jal 0x203ac2 (main loop: finish preparation after 550 ms, then sub_22F2C7)
b.jal 0x268c55 -> b.jal 0x203b33 (boot: prepare panel, then sub_268C55)

notes: Boot (0x2620CC): vendor panel-on up to the link training, then a 550 ms countdown (1 ms ISR timer slot 8, 0x455179/0x45518A) instead of the busy-wait; the main loop then sets pnl = 1 and output mode 0 (vendor order). A panel-on before the countdown ends waits for the rest, so training -> backlight stays >= 550 ms. Panel-off also runs during the countdown. Same idea as the LG 28MQ780 panel state machine.
